descriptionChirho: Intense anger or fury, especially divine wrath poured out in judgment; the primary and most common sense of the word across all inflections, pronominal suffixes, and prepositional prefixes.
Overbearing pride or insolent behavior that oversteps proper bounds, related to the root sense of crossing over or transgressing limits.
The surging or overflowing aspect of rage, emphasizing the uncontainable excess and outburst of anger, used in the plural form to denote repeated or torrential outpourings.
